callout.expo.title: This app is not connected to Expo
callout.rc.title: This app is not connected to RevenueCat
dialog.askAdmin: Only an owner or an admin can link apps. Ask one of them to connect them.
dialog.description: Review the matches Kiln found. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
dialog.expoHelp: The project id is in app.json under extra.eas.projectId (running “eas init” adds it); you can also enter @account/slug. Kiln cannot list the projects your token sees.
dialog.keyHint: The key is only used to read. Nothing is changed.
dialog.noKey.expo: No Expo token is saved yet. Add an Expo access token first.
dialog.noKey.rc: No RevenueCat key is saved yet. Add a RevenueCat secret key first.
dialog.nothingToDo: Every app that {{name}} can serve is already linked.
dialog.readingExpo: Reading app.json of the linked repositories…
dialog.readingRc: Reading your RevenueCat projects and apps…
dialog.reviewExpo: Kiln read the Expo project id from app.json of each linked repository. Tick the apps to link, or type the project of an app yourself.
dialog.reviewRc: Kiln matched each app to a RevenueCat app by its bundle id or package name and its store. Tick the apps to link. Where several RevenueCat apps fit, choose one: Kiln never guesses.
dialog.safeExpo: Confirming only saves the link in Kiln. Expo is never changed.
dialog.safeRc: Confirming only saves the link in Kiln. RevenueCat is never changed.
dialog.title: Connect your apps to {{name}}
done.expo.appears: Builds of each linked app now shows its EAS builds and submissions, and Settings offers EAS Workflows.
done.expo.empty: The lists stay empty until Expo has been read for the first time (“Read Expo now”, or Read again on Builds), and for as long as the project has no build.
done.rc.appears: Products of each linked app now has a RevenueCat column, with the entitlements and offerings that use each product, and the figures strip.
done.rc.empty: They stay empty until the first sync: it is pending. Kiln has only saved the link; RevenueCat is read by “Sync products”.
expo.name: Expo
missing.expo.keyFound: Kiln has your Expo token “{{label}}”, but this app is not linked to an Expo project, so Builds shows no EAS builds or submissions. Link it in one step; nothing is changed in Expo.
missing.expo.keyFoundAsk: Kiln has an Expo token (“{{label}}”), but this app is not linked to an Expo project, so Builds shows no EAS builds or submissions. Ask an owner or an admin to link it.
missing.expo.noKey: No Expo token is saved yet, and this app is not linked to an Expo project. Add an Expo access token in Credentials first, then link the app.
missing.expo.unknown: This app is not linked to an Expo project, so Builds shows no EAS builds. An Expo token and the link are needed; an owner or an admin can set them up.
missing.rc.keyFound: Kiln has your RevenueCat key “{{label}}”, but this app is not linked to a RevenueCat project, so the RevenueCat column, entitlements and offerings stay empty. Link it in one step; nothing is changed in RevenueCat.
missing.rc.keyFoundAsk: Kiln has a RevenueCat key (“{{label}}”), but this app is not linked to a RevenueCat project, so nothing from RevenueCat is shown. Ask an owner or an admin to link it.
missing.rc.noKey: No RevenueCat key is saved yet, and this app is not linked to a RevenueCat project. Add a RevenueCat secret key in Credentials first, then link the app.
missing.rc.unknown: This app is not linked to a RevenueCat project, so nothing from RevenueCat is shown. A RevenueCat key and the link are needed; an owner or an admin can set them up.
rc.name: RevenueCat
row.expo.none: No project found. Type its id or @account/slug.
row.rc.ambiguous: Several RevenueCat apps fit. Choose one.
row.rc.none: No match by identifier. Choose a RevenueCat app, or leave the app unlinked.
row.rc.nothing: No RevenueCat app of this store was found with this key.
row.rc.proposed: Match found: the bundle id or package name and the store agree.
